_about: On the rise: tools we're watching that don't have a score yet. Honorable mentions, never ranked, and never paid for. Each shows only the evidence it already has (independent lists that name it, citable reviews counted so far) and how far it is from earning a score (minReviews citable reviews from foundation sources, plus a recruiter walkthrough). Re-checked monthly; a tool graduates into the rankings when it crosses the line. Every evidence line must trace to a list or source we can link. verified=false: read from search listings, confirmed on the live page at the next check. Each tool records why it is here (trigger, see discovery.json), the month its check is due (checkDue), and the scoreboard it would rank on (board; null means its category has no board yet, a category gap).

tools.name: Huntr
tools.what: Tracks every application on one board, saves jobs from any site, and builds and tailors your resume for each one.
tools.board: Resume tools: ATS checkers, beside Teal
tools.missing: A recruiter walkthrough, which is 40% of the score. Reviews, traffic and pricing are in.

scoring.userBasis: Chrome Web Store, about 1,300 ratings (shown as 1.3K), read live. Trustpilot excluded by policy; Product Hunt pending permission; G2 blocks automated reading.
scoring.formula: Same as every resume tool: traffic = 8.5911 - 1.1978 x log10(rank); volume = -0.5847 + 1.5918 x log10(reviews), clamped 1 to 5; footprint = their average; market = half footprint, half the neutral 2.5 momentum prior.
scoring.pricing: Free: unlimited base resumes, free PDF export, 2 job-tailored resumes, basic matching and scoring, up to 100 tracked jobs. Pro: $40 a month, $90 every 3 months, or $160 every 6 months.
